categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the 'P2P' label and modifies AddrMan address freshness logic in 'src/addrman.cpp'.
categories.rationale: Fixes a logic bug where AddrMan compares unadjusted incoming timestamps against penalized stored timestamps, unnecessarily inflating an address's multiplicity. As the author notes in the PR description, 'this is just a small logic bugfix, it doesn't change things in adversarial scenarios', making it worthwhile hygiene rather than an urgent security fix.
